parsed.reason: Description A says denied requests don't advance updated_at, so repeated denied calls re-add the same elapsed interval and over-refill the bucket, letting clients exceed the rate limit. Description B says a cost greater than capacity can never be satisfied because tokens are capped at capacity, so such requests are always denied. These are different failures (over-admission from refill accounting versus permanent denial for oversized costs) at overlapping lines.
